sector_model: Small-cap enterprise software with flat growth: value on FCF after SBC and capitalized software, convertible debt versus cash, buybacks versus FCF; GAAP net income is distorted by a prior-year tax valuation allowance release.
thesis: PagerDuty (NYSE: PD), fiscal year ends Jan 31. Q2 FY27 10-Q (to 2026-07-31; first 100,000 of 101,450 characters read) and 2026-08-27 release read. Revenue 124.4M (+0.8%), six months 245.4M (+0.9%); ARR 501.4M (+0.5%); dollar-based net retention 98%; GAAP operating income 10.2M (8.2%), non-GAAP 23.7%; Q2 FCF 32.8M (26.3%). Guide: Q3 revenue 123.0M to 125.0M, FY27 491.5M to 496.5M (below FY26 492.5M at midpoint, about flat), non-GAAP operating margin 25.0% to 26.0%. About 15% headcount reduction announced August 2026, charges 5.5M to 7.5M mostly in Q3. TTM revenue 495M, FCF 117M (OCF 131M less capex and capitalized software 14M), SBC 81M, FCF after SBC 37M. Close 15.81 on 2026-11-18 x 78,649,873 shares (10-Q cover 2026-08-25) = 1,243M market cap; FCF yield 9.4% (3.0% after SBC); net cash about 67.5M, EV about 1,176M, EV/revenue 2.4x. The screen's 35% net margin is not real: TTM net income 184M includes about 161.6M Q3 FY26 net income largely from releasing a valuation allowance. The market prices a no-growth, AI-exposed incident software vendor; the case for a different view is cash conversion (about 24% FCF margin) and SBC falling to about 14% of revenue in the first half, but there is no growth, retention is below 100%, and the margin gain is partly cost cuts.
counterthesis: Revenue and ARR are flat and net retention is 98%, so the base is shrinking within accounts; AI-driven observability and incident tools can substitute. SBC is about 80M TTM, about 68% of FCF, leaving FCF after SBC near 37M. Buybacks of about 208M TTM exceeded TTM FCF of 117M; the 2025 notes were repaid (57.5M in Q2) and 402.5M of 2028 converts remain against cash and investments of 470.0M. Cash plus investments was flat from January to July despite those outflows and the movement is not reconciled here. Restructuring may flatter margins without restoring growth.
invalidation: Invalidated if ARR turns negative with net retention below 95%, if FCF after SBC stays under 3% of market cap, if repurchases are funded from cash while 2028 converts are unaddressed, or if a take-private or growth reacceleration thesis fails to appear and margins fall.
